spans.s:
m. (-यः)
A house, a habitation.
E.
नि in, ली to embrace, affix घ.

n. (-नं)
Place, dwelling.
E.
नि before ली to endeavour, ल्युट् aff.

f. (-ता)
Dwelling, domesticality.
E.
निलायिन्, and तल् aff.

mfn. (-यी-यिनी-यि)
Dwelling in, inhabiting.
E.
नि before ली to embrace, णिनि aff.

m. (-म्पः)
A deity.
f. (-म्पा)
A cow.
E.
नि in or on, लिम्प to smear, affix खञ्.

f. (-का)
A cow.
E.
कन् added to the preceding.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
1 Encompassed, surrounded, shut or wrapt up, embraced.
2 Destroyed, perished entirely.
3 Transformed, changed.
4 Fused in or into.
5 Full.
E.
नि in or on, ली to embrace, affix क्त, deriv. irr.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Blue, dark blue or black.
m. (-लः)
1 Black or dark blue, (the colour.)
2 The blue mountain, one of the principal ranges of mountains, dividing the world into nine portions, and lying immediately north of Hāvrata or the central division.
3 One of the monkey chiefs.
4 One of the Nidhis or divine treasures of

KUVERA.
5

A gem, (the sapphire.)
6 A [] name of the Buddha MAÑ

JUGHOṢA.
7

The blue or hill Maina, a bird so called.
n. (-लं)
1 Indigo, the dye.
2 A mark, a characteristick mark.
3 A medical plant, apparently distinct form the

Indigofera.
4

Blue vitriol.
5 Black salt.
6

Poison.
7

Antimony.
f. (-ला)
1 A blue fly.
2 A Rāgiṇī or mode of music, personified as the wife of the Rāga Mallāra.
f. (ली)
1 The indigo plant, (Indigofera tinctoria.)
2 A complaint of the eyes, a darkening of the pupil.
3 A bruise, a black and blue mark on the skin.
E.
नील to dye or tinge, क aff. or नीली indigo, अन् aff., implying being coloured or stained by it.

m. (-कः)
1 The Nil Gao or slate coloured antilope, (A. picta.)
2 A tree, (Pentaptera tomentosa.)
n. (-कं)
1 Blue steel.
2 Blue vitriol.
3 Black salt.
E.
कन् added to the preceding.

m. (-ण्ठः)
1 A name of Ś

IVA.
2

A gallinule.
3 A sparrow.
4 A wagtail.
5 A peacock.
6 Morunga, (Hyperanthera morunga.)
7 A blue jay.
E.
नील blue or black, and कण्ठ the throat; also कालकण्ठ.

n. (-क्षं)
The Eloeocarpus seed.
E.
नीलकण्ठ ŚIVA, and अक्ष seed.

n. (-लं)
The blue lotus.
E.
नील, and कमल a lotus.

m. (-कः)
Blue Barleria, (B. cærulea.)
E.
नील, and कुरुण्टक Barleria.

m. (-ञ्चः)
A sort of curlew or heron.
E.
नील blue, and क्रौञ्च a heron, &c.

m. (-वः)
A name of MAHĀDEVA.
E.
नील blue, and ग्रीवा neck; the neck of ŚIVA was stained blue by the acrimony of the poison, which, upon its production at the churning of the ocean, he swallowed.

m. (-ङ्गुः)
1 An insect in general.
2 A sort of worm.
3 A Shakal.
E.
नि before लगि to go, Uṇādi aff. कु, and the इ of नि made long.

m. (-ङ्गुः)
1 An insect in general.
2 A sort of insect.
3 A Shakāl.
f. (-ङ्गुः)
A gad-fly.
E.
see नीलङ्गु the penultimate being irregularly made long.

mfn. (-जः-जा-जं)
Produced in the blue mountain, &c.
n. (-जं)
Blue steel.
E.
नील, and ज produced.

f. (-ण्टी)
Blue Barleria.
E.
नील blue, and भिण्टी Barleria.

Darkness.
2

Black mud.
E.
नील black, and पङ्क clay or mire.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Very dark or black.
E.
नील, and पटल abundance.

mfn. (-त्रः-त्रा-त्रं)
Having black or dark blue leaves.
n. (-त्रं)
The blue lotus.
E.
नील blue, and पत्र leaf.

n. (-नं)
Steeping or maceration of indigo.
E.
नील, and पाचन cooking.

n. (-ण्डं)
An indigo vat.
E.
नीलपाचन, and भाण्ड vessel.

n. (-द्मं)
The blue lotus, (Nymphæa cærulea.)
E.
नील, and पद्म a lotus.

m. (-च्छः)
A falcon.
E.
नील blue, and पिच्छ a tail.

m. (-ष्पः)
A sort of Verbesina with blue flowers.
f. (-ष्पी)
A blue species of Rasan.
E.
नील blue, and पुष्प flower.

f. (-का)
The indigo plant.
E.
कन् added to नीलपुष्पी.

m. (-ष्ठः)
A sort of fish, commonly called Rohi, (Cyprinus denticulatus.)
E.
नील blue, पृष्ठ the back.

m. (-भः)
1 The moon.
2 A cloud.
3 A bee.
E.
नील blue or black, भा to shine, to show, aff. क.

mfn. (-भः-भा-भं)
Blue.
m. (-भः)
A cloud.
E.
नील, and आभ what shines.

m. (-णिः)
A gem of a blue colour, the sapphire.
E.
नील blue, and मणि a jewel.

m. (-वः)
A name of KṚṢṆA.
E.
नील, and माधव VIṢṆU, being of a dark colour.

m. (-कः)
A firefly.
E.
नील black or dark blue, मील to twinkle, aff. टक्.

f. (-का)
1 Iron pyrites.
2 Black mould.
E.
नील, and मृत्तिका earth.

n. (-हं)
Blue steel.
E.
नील blue, and लोह iron.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Purple, of a purple colour.
m. (-तः)
1 A name of Ś

IVA.
2

A mixture of red and blue, purple.
f. (-त्ता)
A vegetable: see भूमिजम्बु.
E.
नील blue or black, and लोहित red.

mfn. (-र्णः-र्णी-र्णं)
Blue, of a blue colour.
E.
नील, and वर्ण colour.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Wearing dark blue or black garments.
m. (-नः)
The planet Saturn.
E.
नील dark blue, and वसन vesture.

mfn. (-स्त्रः-स्त्रा-स्त्रं)
Dressed in dark blue or black vesture.
n. (-स्त्रं)
Dark coloured cloth.
m. (-स्त्रः)
A name of BALARĀMA.
E.
नील, and वस्त्र clothes.

mfn. (-साः-साः-सः)
Dressed in dark blue clothes.
m. (-साः)
A name of Saturn.
E.
नील dark blue, वासस् raiment.

m. (-षः)
A dark coloured bull.
E.
नील, and वृष a bull.

m. (-क्षः)
A goose.
E.
नील, and अक्ष an eye, having dark blue eyes.

m. (-ङ्गः)
1 The Indian crane.
2 The blue jay.
E.
नील blue, and अङ्ग body.

n. (-नं)
Blue vitriol.
f. (-ना)
Lightning.
E.
नील blue, अञ्जन collyrium, &c.

f. (-सा)
1 One of the Apsarasas or courtezans of

Svarga.
2

The name of a river.
3 Lightning.
E.
नील dark, अञ्जस quickly, affs. अच् and टाप्.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Dressed in dark blue cloth.
m. (-रः)
1 A name of

BALARĀMA.
2

A demon, a goblin.
3 A name of ŚANI or Saturn.
n. (-रं)
Black or dark blue rainment.
E.
नील, and अम्बर clothing, &c.

n. (-न्म)
The blue lotus.
E.
नील, and अम्बुजन्मन् a lotus.

m. (-भ्रः)
A dark cloud.
E.
नील, and अभ्र cloud.

m. (-श्मा)
A blue stone, a sapphire.
E.
नील, and अश्मन् a stone.

f. (-का)
1 A plant, (Nyctanthes tristis); a species with blue flowers.
2 The indigo plant.
3 A slight malady; black and blue marks on the body from bruises, &c.
E.
कन् added to नीली.

f. (-नी)
1 Indigo, (Indigofera tinctoria.)
2 A black species of Tëori.
E.
नील black or dark blue, poss. aff. इनि fem. aff. ङीप्.

m. (-गः)
1 A firm and constant friend.
2 Firm, unalterable attachment, (as that of RĀMA and SĪTĀ.)
3 Dark blue.
E.
नीली indigo, and राग colour; as permanent as the dye of indigo.

n. (-नं)
Fermentation or maceration of indigo.
E.
नीली, and सन्धान fermentation.

n. (-ण्डं)
An indigo vat.
E.
नीलीसन्धान, and भाण्ड vessel.

n. (-लं)
A blue lotus, (Nymphæa cærulea.)
E.
नील blue, and उत्पल a lotus.

m. (-ली)
One of the Jaina saints or teachers.

n. (-लं)
A blue stone, lapis lazuli.
E.
नील, and उपल a stone.
